Upon medical findings, I was diagnosed with PCOS and a polyp growth in my uterus.
We decided to travel back in Jan 2023 for the surgical procedure. During that time the international team assisted us with all requirements, answered our endless queries that built our confidence to trust them with our health matters.
Dr. Chaitali Trivedi and her team were very reassuring that all will be well. They were very kind and courteous during the whole process that made me feel safe and thank God all went well with minimal post operation pains. I am greatful for the entire team for coming togather and making this medical journey easier for me.

Once again Thank you Mr. Tarandeep, Dr. Chaitali Trivedi and Nanavati Max team.

featured_reviews.name: TUSHAR SHINDE
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a pathetic experience at Balajee Hospital, Malad East, following my surgery. I highly regret choosing this facility and would advise everyone to stay away.
• Terrible Hygiene: The hospital environment is disgusting. There is no separate washroom for patients; the nurses, staff, and patients all share the same toilet. It is extremely unhygienic and a massive infection risk, especially for someone recovering from surgery.
• Not Worth the Money: The rooms and beds are incredibly expensive, but the quality is "third class." You pay premium prices for sub-standard, dirty facilities.
• Poor Management: The management clearly doesn't care about basic sanitation or patient comfort.
This hospital is not worth your money or your health. Do yourself a favor and go to a better, cleaner hospital in Malad. I will never come back here again.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Gole
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mr. Prashant Visariya:
My brother was admitted to Balajee Hospital due to severe stomach pain, and he was later diagnosed with an appendix issue. During such a stressful time for our family, the support we received from Mr. Prashant made a significant difference.

The admission process was handled very quickly and smoothly because of him. As a Mediclaim Manager, Mr. Prashant managed the entire admission and mediclaim procedure with great care and professionalism. He ensured that the process was completed without causing any inconvenience or stress to our family.

What impressed us the most was that his first priority was always the patient’s well-being. He did not trouble us for unnecessary documentation and guided us clearly on which reports were mandatory and which expenses were not covered under the mediclaim. He also supported us in arranging those requirements.

His helpful attitude, kindness, and dedication towards patients and their families are truly commendable. In difficult situations like medical emergencies, having such supportive staff makes a huge difference.

Thank you very much, Mr. Prashant, for your kind and supportive behavior. Your assistance and professionalism are greatly appreciated.

I would also like to mention Dr. Komal Ma’am, who was extremely supportive and encouraging throughout the process. She gave me a lot of courage regarding the surgery and helped ease my anxiety. I sincerely wish her great success in her medical career and pray that she continues to grow as an excellent doctor in her field.

From the bottom of my heart, I pray that Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta’ala blesses Suchak Hospital, Mrs. Abha Anil Suchak, Dr. Suraj Suchak, Dr. Komal, and their entire team. Popular treatments include heart surgeries, cancer treatment, bone marrow transplants, obesity management, infertility treatment, dental treatments and implants, organ transplants, and multiple failure organ treatments.

featured_reviews.review_text: My name is Arnold and I had brought my father for treatment in India. I honestly don’t have the words to describe the really good treatment and care we got from planned medical tourism team. From really great accommodation to tailored consultations and more importantly personal interaction and consultations. We had our personal healthcare consultant who walked with us every step of the way and by the time treatment was done he had become family🙏🏼🙏🏼. From personalized affordable consultations to always being the even when my dad had emergencies during the wee hours of the night to being available even during holidays and non working days, all I can say is thank you thank you thank you. My father and I really enjoyed our stay in India mainly due to the personalized care Planned Medical Tourism gave. To Rohan and his colleagues at Planned Medical Tourism may God bless you and keep doing the divine work you do. Asante sana!!
